lines.en: Two days had passed since the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’ ended.
The nightmare-filled ‘Reincarnation Island’ was no longer visible. The constellations were gradually leaving the ark to return to their own places among the stars.
—This stop is <Olympus>.
At the announcement inside the ship, the constellations of <Olympus> rose. Dionysus, standing as their representative, looked at Jung Heewon and said,
[Sorry to leave first when you’re having such a hard time.]
“It’s all right.”
[Don’t worry too much. It’s him we’re talking about, not some other constellation. I’m sure he’s alive.]

Patting her shoulder, Dionysus led the constellations away beyond the dark dimension. Jung Heewon waited silently until they had all disappeared, then descended from the ark’s bow. At the bottom of the stairs, she found someone waiting. Han Sooyoung.
“Dionysus?”
“Gone.”
“Cheok Jungyeong and <Underworld>, too?”
“They’ll probably leave a little later.”
“What about Uriel?”

Han Sooyoung kept asking, and Jung Heewon kept answering. Mostly small pieces of information. Hades and Persephone. Uriel. Where Cheok Jungyeong was staying. Who was leaving, who was staying, and who would be with them…… Some of it both already knew. But who knew what wasn’t particularly important.
“Hayoung’s completely exhausted. The teachers are helping with recovery by working the pressure points and circulating energy.”
“Jihye?”
“Repairing the broken battleship at the stern.”
“Lee Hyunsung?”
One asked, the other answered. Walking the ark’s corridors, they did nothing but repeat that exchange. As though they could not bear even a moment without it.
“The kids?”
“The kids……”
Before Jung Heewon could finish, the children’s voices came from inside a cabin along the corridor.
—As I thought, I should make a dark contract right now and avenge hyung……
—What revenge? Ajusshi’s definitely alive. I can feel it.
—……I know that, too, okay? If it’s Dokja-hyung, he’ll definitely……!
—Get a grip. This is the time to make a sound plan.
As though by agreement, Jung Heewon and Han Sooyoung stopped to listen. Until just a day ago, the children had been crying and wailing uncontrollably. But now, through the cabin window, they looked……
“……They seem all right.”
After a beat, Han Sooyoung asked Jung Heewon,
“And you?”
Jung Heewon did not answer. Her gaze slowly fell. Instead of looking at her, Han Sooyoung looked in the same direction. Jung Heewon spoke.
“He asked me to save him.”
“Me. He asked me to save him.”
A tightly clenched fist. There were sensations they could share without looking at one another. It sounded as though dry rain was falling somewhere. Silently listening, Han Sooyoung said,
“There’s a lot to do when we get back.”
“……Yeah. I know.”
Rubbing her face with her sleeve, Jung Heewon gave a feeble smile.
“We should go to Seoul first, right?”
“Yeah.”
“There’ll definitely be people targeting Seoul while Dokja-ssi’s gone. We’ll need to restore order when we get there.”
“Who’s going to tell Lee Sookyung?”
“That’s……”
They fell silent and stared into the air for a while. Han Sooyoung spoke first.
“We need Yoo Sangah at times like this.”
“……I miss Sangah-ssi.”
They had lost too much.
Turning their heads, they saw the dark dimension passing beyond the cabin windows. Stars shone beyond distant galaxies.
The universe does not suddenly end just because a single star disappears.
Because there are countless stars in the universe, and light still exists.
But to those living on a certain planet, that star was all the light they knew.
Han Sooyoung forced herself to look away from Jung Heewon’s reflection in the window. Jung Heewon murmured,
“What on earth happened to Dokja-ssi?”

Without answering, Han Sooyoung led the way. Soon, they reached the room at the end of the corridor. Opening the door carefully, they found Yoo Joonghyuk lying covered in bandages. Rummaging inside her clothes, Han Sooyoung took out a lemon candy and said,
“……We’ll know when this bastard wakes up.”
It was back when I was engrossed in ‘Ways of Survival.’
As usual, satisfied with finishing my day’s routine, I scrolled down and found something written in the [Author’s Note] section.
—What do you think, dear reader?
I had forgotten what the question concerned. It might have been the plot, or a clue within the story. What had I answered?
Before I could remember, my younger self’s fingers pressed the keys.
—Hmm. Such a simple twist is a little……
—So you think so, too?
Looking into the memory, I was surprised anew. Had something like this happened? I remembered ‘Ways of Survival’ so well. Why had I completely forgotten memories like these?
Right. Come to think of it, the author of ‘Ways of Survival’ had occasionally spoken to me.
And I, too, had sometimes spoken to the author through comments. Usually encouragement or questions about the next installment, though at times I raised objections.
I thought it had been just after Yoo Joonghyuk passed his six-hundredth round.
After reading the novel, I couldn’t make sense of it no matter how much I thought about it, so I finally challenged the author in a comment.
—Author-nim. Isn’t that a typo? Joonghyuk ‘beaming’?
tls123 replied.
—Anyone would be like that after regressing about six hundred times.
Put that way, it seemed plausible, and I had no reply. I thought that was the first time I had seriously considered the number of Yoo Joonghyuk’s regressions.
Six hundred regressions. What could life possibly mean to someone who lived life over and over like that?
「Kim Dok ja get a grip」

With a throbbing in my head, consciousness slowly returned. My whole body was stiff, severe pain coming from all over my incarnation body. When I finally opened my eyes, faint light stabbed my retinas. Then I heard a familiar voice.
“You seem to be awake.”
Well, speak of the devil.
I chuckled and turned my eyes toward him.
But something was strange.
“Are you Kim Dokja?”
When I opened my eyes, I was surrounded by countless Yoo Joonghyuks.
It took another ten minutes or so for me to recover my senses.
Having briefly fainted again, I did not open my eyes immediately. Instead, I struggled to understand what had happened to me. First, I needed to sort things out.
One: the Great War of Saints and Demons was over.
That seemed certain.
Above all, the messages remaining in my log proved it.
[You have acquired the Giant Story ‘Season of Light and Darkness’!]
[Your third Giant Story has completed the ‘Climax (轉)’!]
[The third condition of the hidden scenario ― ‘A Single Story’ has been fulfilled!]
[The final Story awaits you.]
[The entire <Star Stream> is abuzz with your achievement!]
[Many nebulae of the <Star Stream> pay attention to your nebula!]
[The overwhelming majority of constellations, your Story……]
At last, I had completed the Climax (轉) of ‘A Single Story.’
Tremendous Story energy surged within me.
The Giant Story 「Season of Light and Darkness」.

Even I had never heard of a Giant Story by that name. Naturally. Pitting the Nameless Mist against the Apocalypse Dragon had never happened in the original…… This would probably trigger upheaval across the entire worldline.
With the flow of destruction accelerated, the progression of the scenarios would have to accelerate, too.
And two: someone had rescued me.
That was where the problem began. Who had rescued me?
“There’s no point pretending to be unconscious.”
For the record, the last thing I had seen was Yoo Joonghyuk coming to save me. Perhaps it was natural, then, to see his face before me.
The problem was……
“Apparently, he doesn’t just look stupid. He’s stupid, too.”
“Just as we heard.”
Why were there several ‘Yoo Joonghyuks’?
And what was more……
Blankly, I stared at the five or six ‘Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuks’ standing on the bed. They were unmistakably Yoo Joonghyuk, but all had oversized heads and were about Kyrgios’s height.
……Was this a dream?
It had to be. All the stress he had given me had piled up to create this terrible delusion. As I slapped my cheeks, the Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuks spoke.
“He thinks he’s dreaming. Foolishly.”
“He seems to need time to understand the situation.”
“What a nuisance. Must we wait?”
Ignoring them, I looked around the room.
It was a large, circular room. The table, chairs, furnishings, even the bed I sat on were round.
……Where on earth was I?
I thought hard, but nothing came to mind. An inner chamber this distinctive should have been memorable, yet I could not recall it from ‘Ways of Survival.’
Wondering whether this was a new scenario area, I called up the scenario window. To make matters worse, this message appeared.
[The <Star Stream>’s scenario system is currently under maintenance.]
In the end, there was nothing I could find out in my current state.
“He seems to have more or less grasped the situation.”
“I’ll ask again. Are you Kim Dokja?”
A fierce-eyed Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk asked. Looking closely, I saw different number tags on their chests. The one who had just asked wore [999].
I decided to answer for now.
“Yes. I’m Kim Dokja.”
The Yoo Joonghyuks looked at one another and nodded in unison.
The little bastards. Tiny as they were, they acted exactly like the real Yoo Joonghyuk.
“Apparently, the right one was brought here.”
Even their voices……
I did not understand, but by now I had to accept it.
This was not a dream. Through some unknown whim of probability, I had arrived in a fantasy kingdom inhabited by Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuks.
“Who are you?”
I decided to ask first. If they really were Yoo Joonghyuk, there was no way they would answer plainly. One of them muttered,
“Pathetic. Can’t you tell by looking?”

As expected. If I had to come somewhere like this, I wished it were a world of kind Kkoma Yoo Sangahs. As I considered how to provoke an answer, the Yoo Joonghyuk with [888] on his chest said something unexpected.
“With that brain of yours, you could think for a hundred days and still not understand, so I’ll tell you. We are part of the ‘Great Plotter.’”
……Great Plotter? Could it be?
A chilling sensation crossed my mind.
Apparently interpreting my silence in his own way, the Yoo Joonghyuk marked [777] sneered.
“Your pathetic intelligence could never understand.”
Yes. Yoo Joonghyuk.
These were definitely Yoo Joonghyuks.
“If you’ve recovered, move. Someone is waiting for you.”
“Who’s waiting for me?”
“You’ll see.”

Staggering to my feet, I followed him. A round door opened onto a large corridor. Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999] led the way. I followed [999], and a little cluster of Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuks trailed after me. I asked,
“Where are we?”
A Yoo Joonghyuk following behind answered,
“eun gui ei soup.”
“What are you talking about?”
“It means ‘N’Gai’s Forest.’ You call yourself a prophet and don’t even know that?”
No, why say it like a foreign language?
The Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk marked [666] gave me a scornful look, then turned his head away with a snort.
It suddenly occurred to me that those numbers might represent Yoo Joonghyuk’s ‘regression rounds.’
……What had happened in his 666th round?
Was that a round when he traveled with the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon?
A silver forest shone through the corridor’s windows. ‘N’Gai’s Forest.’ It sounded vaguely familiar. But I didn’t think this had been a setting in ‘Ways of Survival’……
Just then, a group walked toward us from the other end of the corridor.
【Is that the one the Plotter brought?】
No, could I really call that ‘walking’?
My hair stood on end, and I found myself gripping [Unbreakable Faith]’s hilt.
A group of ‘Outer Gods’ was walking toward us.

Their aura was incomparably more ominous than that of constellations. Monsters with horse heads, repulsive tentacles covering their bodies. The tentacles stretching into the air briefly cocked their heads, then began creeping toward me. No one could have called those movements friendly.
Unexpectedly, it was Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999] who blocked them.
“He is our guest. Do not touch him without permission.”
【Surely a conversation would not matter.】
“I have not permitted it.”
With that, Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999] drew a miniature [Splitting the Sky Sword] from his back.
Then Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [888], Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [777], and Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [666], too. They all drew swords from their backs and waists.
……Could these guys fight, too?
They just looked like figurines to me.
Apparently thinking the same thing, the other side began displaying persistent hostility.
【You dare…… Just because you are dependents of the ‘Great Plotter’……】
Just as the tentacles and Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuks were about to clash, a boom resounded from somewhere in the forest. All the ‘Outer Gods’ writhing their tentacles collapsed.
Only the horse-headed one who had shown hostility toward me rose again.
Then another boom sounded. At last, even the horse-headed one slammed its head into the floor. This was no simple seismic wave.
Someone was intimidating them with tremendous Status.
【Uuuuh……】

Groaning, the Outer Gods moved aside together. At the end of the cleared path appeared the entrance to a great hall. An open hall with countless tree vines growing through its broad, circular ceiling. I walked inside with the Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuks.
A thread of sunlight illuminated an old throne at the center of the hall.
No one told me, but I knew.
That being was the king of this forest.
What was more, I knew him.
A scar on the face emerging from the faint sunlight’s shadows. A white coat identical to mine.
Someone I had believed I would never see again sat there.
【It has been a while, Kim Dokja.】

I slowly examined the being before me. My heart raced, and my breathing grew rough. Something had touched a box of memories that should have remained untouched. Words spilled from the box I had buried deep in the darkness.
「“Where is ‘Arondight’? Do you have it?”」
That had been our first face-to-face encounter.
Gripping my collar, he had asked me that.
「“If you won’t answer, I’ll have to find out by force.”」
There was the golden [Sage’s Eye], shining exactly as it had then.
My head throbbed, and my vision blurred like an abstract painting. The voices continued.
「“Does ‘that world’ you showed me really exist?”」
「This person is not a ‘character.’」
Everyone has memories they want to forget but must not. Perhaps, for me, those were the memories of that round.
I had failed to save that round’s Yoo Joonghyuk. The Yoo Joonghyuk who had set off for a new round in a white coat.
Leaving the 1863rd-round Han Sooyoung and me behind, he had departed freely into brilliant light. I had never forgotten that retreating figure, not for an instant.
“You’re……”
For a long time, I stared up at the Yoo Joonghyuk on the throne, dazed.
The scar on his cheek, his gaunt face, his dark, sunken gaze.
In every detail, he was the 1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk I remembered.
But the surprises did not end there.
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ is looking at you.]
……Secretive Plotter?

Only then did I notice the ominous, malevolent energy rising from Yoo Joonghyuk’s body. An Evil (惡) different from that of Demon Kings. Chaos that could not be defined by the <Star Stream>’s Good and Evil.
Just as I tried to speak, something inside my coat radiated brilliant light.
[The exclusive attribute ‘Scenario Interpreter’ activates!]
[The Giant Story ‘Season of Light and Darkness’ reacts to your attribute.]
As though it had been waiting for this, the Story began spilling words.
Two Yoo Joonghyuks stood there.
「【Go back. You cannot save anything.】」
「“……Secretive Plotter?”」
Scenes flashed through my mind like fast-forwarding footage. The information was fragmented, but enough for me to understand what had happened.
……So that was it.
Little by little, I understood the present situation.
Then came Yoo Joonghyuk falling, Lee Jihye catching him, and the ark leaving the island, one after another. Thankfully, <Kim Dokja’s Company> seemed to have escaped ‘Reincarnation Island’ safely.
[The Giant Story ‘Season of Light and Darkness’ stops its storytelling.]
After a quiet sigh of relief, I looked up at the being on the throne.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ looked down at me in turn.
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ activates strongly!]
My heart calmed, and reason gradually returned.
I took a gentle, deep breath, then spoke.
“If looking like that was a strategy to unsettle me, I’d call it a resounding success.”
【Did you not speak respectfully to me before?】
“You appeared as Yoo Joonghyuk. I’m just treating you accordingly.”
Seeing me refuse to be cowed, the ‘Secretive Plotter’ moved his lips in apparent amusement. Ignoring that, I continued.
“Secretive Plotter. I propose ‘Sacred Three-Question Exchange.’”
【Why should I accept?】
“You cannot be the ‘1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk.’ It’s impossible.”
【Why do you think so?】
“Want to know? For the record, I have three reasons.”
A curious light crossed his eyes.
“Well? Will you do it or not?”
【A very interesting offer, but not a fair one.】
For a while, he watched me quietly. His eyes looked thoughtful, or perhaps angry.
How much time passed? The Secretive Plotter’s left eyebrow twitched sharply. A passage from ‘Ways of Survival’ came to mind.
「When Yoo Joonghyuk makes a grave decision, his left eyebrow twitches.」
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ said,
【I will impose a condition.】
“What condition?”
【You must wonder why I brought you here.】
I nodded. Of course I wondered.
【But you may not ask me that. I cannot tell you. Some answers can only be found by discovering the questions yourself.】
“What kind of Sakyamuni nonsense is that?”
【I will accept ‘Sacred Three-Question Exchange.’ You may ask me three questions from this moment onward. However, you may not ask ‘why I brought you here.’】
“Is that the condition?”
【One more. Once all three questions have been used, you must discover ‘why you had to come here.’】
That was so unexpected that I was momentarily flustered.
“What if I can’t?”
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ did not answer.
He merely raised a long finger slowly and set it down on the armrest with a tap.
That alone sent goosebumps down my back.
「Could I win now?」
I examined my Stories one by one.
From Legendary-grade Stories to Giant Stories……
“You’d better stop that foolishness.”
It was Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999] beside me. I chuckled and looked down at him.
“Are you worrying about me?”
“Cleaning up a corpse is merely a nuisance.”
“……What exactly are you guys?”
【Using your question? Very well.】
“No, wait—”
Before I could answer, messages appeared.
―The Sacred Three-Question Exchange (三問答) begins.
―Both parties may exchange three questions and answers.
―Each party may refuse to answer once.
―The exchange will not end until all questions and answers have been fully exchanged.
—The first question is used.
I saw Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [666] smile nastily beside me.
Damn bastards.
Still, since it had come to this, hearing the answer wouldn’t be a bad thing.
【They are my dependents.】

“You’re not really going to stop there, are you? Since you’re telling me, give me a little more. What kind of dependents? Like [Avatar], or the dependents Demon Kings have? I’d appreciate a clear answer.”
I rattled on as carefully as possible so it wouldn’t sound like a second question.
Then Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [777] sighed.
“You really do talk too much.”
“I wasn’t asking you.”
【They are beings who have received my memories.】
—You have received the first answer.
“So it’s something like the [Avatar] skill.”
【My turn. Give me the first reason I am not the ‘1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk.’】
“If you really came from the 1863rd round, there’s no way you’d be wearing that ‘white coat.’”

“The stigma ‘Regression’ sends only your soul into the past, not the items you possess. The coat I gave the 1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk disappeared when he regressed. If you really are from that round, you couldn’t be wearing it.”
【Interesting. But this is simply an item I obtained myself.】
“Yoo Joonghyuk doesn’t wear white much.”
【……Ask your second question.】
—The second question is used.
I spoke without hesitation.
“Second question. Are you the ‘1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk’?”
At my question, the Secretive Plotter’s expression shifted slightly.
【……Are you playing games?】
“No, I’m asking seriously.”
【I was Yoo Joonghyuk, who experienced the 1863rd round.】
“Past tense.”
【Now I am merely the ‘Secretive Plotter.’】
—You have received the second answer.
Unless an exception clause was in place, ‘Sacred Three-Question Exchange’ required one to speak only the truth. Otherwise, one would immediately be caught in a probability backlash.
Yet the ‘Secretive Plotter’ showed no particular sign of it.
【Give me the second reason I am not the ‘1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk.’】
“There are too many contradictions for you to be him.”
【What contradictions?】
“If you really are the 1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk, why did you send me to the 1863rd round and order me to kill you? It makes no logical sense.”
【Because that was the only way I could be created. A simple time paradox. I was the 1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk, and only if you killed me there could I be reborn as the ‘Secretive Plotter.’】

“You must have spent a long time preparing that answer. It came out so naturally. But even assuming you’re right, your reaction after I succeeded in the mission didn’t quite fit. You seemed very surprised.”
【……Ask your next question.】
“No. You go first this time. I’ll go last.”
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ looked at me briefly, then spoke.
【Very well. What is the last reason I am not the ‘1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk’?】
“I have a special way of telling that only I can use. I have a skill that reads another person’s mind.”
【And?】
“But the 1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk became someone I couldn’t read.”
I remembered clearly the moment he left for his next round. Breaking free of being a ‘character,’ he had become unreadable to my exclusive skill, [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint].
【Are you saying you can read my thoughts?】
“No. I can’t read you, either.”
【Then?】
“But the reason is different.”
[Activation of ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint’ is canceled!]
[Your understanding of this being is woefully insufficient!]
[Your understanding cannot possibly keep up with this being’s Status!]
I quietly looked up at the messages in the air.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ frowned.
【I cannot accept that as a reason. You—】
“I’ll ask my final question.”
I continued without giving him an opening.
“On the planet where I lived, there’s a novel called 『Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World』.”
The air changed instantly. The Secretive Plotter’s face grew infinitely cold. His gaze was so icy it seemed he might slaughter me at once.
Desperately resisting that pressure, I continued.
It was a question I had wanted to ask for so long.
“Secretive Plotter. Do you know the epilogue of that novel?”
Yoo Joonghyuk dreamed.
It was an old, worn dream.
For some reason, he wore a white coat in it.
The [Splitting the Sky Sword] fit his hand perfectly. Holding that heavy blade, he was fighting someone. Looking closely, he saw that the being before him had the same face.
A Yoo Joonghyuk in a black coat.
He did not know why he was dreaming this.
‘The 1863rd round.’
Perhaps it was because he had met that bastard.
That was why he was having this dream.
Yoo Joonghyuk gritted his teeth. The overwhelming difference in Status he had felt when clashing with the Secretive Plotter was still vivid in his mind.
Regardless of his feelings, the memories slowly seeped into him. He swung his sword as the Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round.
「I will die.」
「I will regress.」
With each clash of swords, he felt the despair and solitude of the 1863rd round. Strangely, it all felt natural.
As though those emotions had been his for a very long time.
Thud!
At last, each man’s sword plunged into the other’s stomach.
「This story ends here.」
「Even so, once again, everything begins anew.」

The black-coated Yoo Joonghyuk scattered first. Then his own body began to disperse. Memories scattered, and the feelings he had barely understood left him. With the last of his strength, Yoo Joonghyuk looked back.
His vision blurred. He could not see what was there.
He merely felt as though he had seen a very bright, dazzling star.
「“I’ve grown curious about that world’s ■■.”」
「“In the next round……”」
With a high-pitched beep, Yoo Joonghyuk’s eyes flew open.
Panting breaths. The white ceiling of a hospital room.
Then he heard a voice.
“Our Sleeping Prince has finally awakened.”
Turning his head, he saw Han Sooyoung and Jung Heewon. Crunching her candy, Han Sooyoung spat the stick onto the floor and growled.
“Care to tell us what the hell happened, esteemed regressor?”
At her prompting, Yoo Joonghyuk began to speak. His account rambled and repeated itself. After ten minutes or so, Han Sooyoung, who had listened silently, spoke.
“Stop. You don’t seem to be thinking straight, so I’ll summarize. Just tell me whether I’m right.”
Normally, he might have protested such a forceful summation. Instead, he merely nodded darkly. Han Sooyoung began.
“You went to save Kim Dokja. But someone snatched him before you could. That was the ‘Secretive Plotter’ we know.”
Yoo Joonghyuk nodded.
“And he had your exact face and wore a white coat.”
“Correct.”
“Could it have been fake? He’s never trustworthy. Maybe the ‘Secretive Plotter’ was disguised as you.”
“It couldn’t be fake.”
“Why?”
“He used the Story my 1863rd-round self possessed.”
“……That chuuni Story, Eternal Something-or-Other?”
“I see,” Han Sooyoung said, nodding. Her pupils dilated slightly, and a Story began to move.
[The Story ‘Predictive Plagiarism’ begins its story!]
Jung Heewon, the only one left out of the conversation, spoke in a confused voice.
“What on earth are you talking about? The ‘Secretive Plotter’ has Joonghyuk-ssi’s face?”
Han Sooyoung looked at her briefly, then sighed.
“Put simply, there are two Yoo Joonghyuks in this worldline.”
“……Is that possible?”
“Nothing says it’s impossible. If a Yoo Joonghyuk from another worldline crossed into this one.”
“He can do that?”
“Kim Dokja visited another worldline in a similar way. The question is how powerful someone who could do that would be……”
Even the highest-ranking constellations of <Eden> or <Papyrus> could not cross worldlines unaided. Yet the ‘Secretive Plotter’ was powerful enough to bear all that probability alone.
Mouth open, Jung Heewon murmured,
“From what kind of worldline……?”
“There’s really only one likely possibility. The 1863rd-round worldline Kim Dokja visited.”
The 1863rd round. Yoo Joonghyuk’s final worldline in 『Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World』. Yoo Joonghyuk asked Han Sooyoung,
“Do you know what happened in that worldline?”
“More or less.”
“At the end of that worldline, my 1863rd-round self split in two and fought. One died. The other regressed.”
“I know. I’ve seen it a few times in dreams, too.”
“……In dreams?”
Han Sooyoung waved a hand as though sick of it.
“We don’t have time to get into that. Anyway, you think the ‘Secretive Plotter’ is your 1863rd-round self. Right?”
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke with a thoroughly displeased expression.
“I’m not certain. A few things bother me.”
“Like what?”
“The ‘Secretive Plotter’ was stronger than the ‘1863rd-round me’ I read about in the records.”
“And?”
“And……”
After biting his lip for a long time, Yoo Joonghyuk said,
“……I felt he was deceiving me about something. That white coat, for instance.”
“The white coat?”
“My stigma, ‘Regression,’ does not carry items back with me. There is no reason for him to be wearing a white coat like that.”
“Maybe he likes white.”
“I hate white.”
“His taste could have changed.”
“It isn’t something you can answer so easily. This is……”
“A matter of feeling?”
Yoo Joonghyuk nodded.
“It felt as though he was mocking me.”
“Mocking you?”
“As though he wore that coat deliberately.”
Rubbing his temple, Yoo Joonghyuk recalled the Secretive Plotter’s words.
【……Third turn. You remember nothing—】
A deep silence settled.
Han Sooyoung rubbed her chin in thought, while Jung Heewon smacked her lips, utterly lost. At last, Han Sooyoung spoke.
“All right. Let’s summarize. Logically, the ‘Secretive Plotter’ is the ‘1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk.’ But your gut feeling says he isn’t. Right?”
“Then let’s start with this assumption. ‘The 1863rd-round Yoo Joonghyuk is not the Secretive Plotter.’ In other words, the ‘Secretive Plotter’ is lying.”
Yoo Joonghyuk’s eyes wavered.
“……It’s only a feeling. You’ll believe that?”
